data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Phaidra is the name of a woman who falls in love with her husband's young student. Her name is derived from the Greek word phos, meaning 'light' or 'bright'. This name evokes images of a shining, radiant woman, full of passion and desire. The name Phaidra carries the meaning “Bright, Shining One” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Phaidra usually hope their child will grow to embody bright, shining one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
